descriptionInUI: AI-only coordination for both sides while an airborne, operating AWACS or a powered command centre survives. Uses detected air contacts, redirects available BARCAP/TARCAP patrols, protects vulnerable flights, and holds attacks behind known SAM threats while DEAD is working. Temporary orders retain the original mission. Excludes Player/Client groups, escorts and AFAC navigation. F10 pause controls allow manual tasking. No emergency scrambles or ground orders. Off by default pending in-simulator validation.

Show command-source changes, decisions and rejection reasons to the owning coalition (at most four debug messages per minute). Also write detailed IMAC|DEBUG diagnostics to dcs.log, including active orders, fuel and remaining lease time. Independent of normal order reports; disabled sides show no debug messages.
